# Core Concepts — Ownership Map

Registry of cross-cutting concepts and which chapter owns the full,
first-principles explanation. Every other chapter that touches a concept below
must write a short recap (2-3 sentences) and link here / to the owning
chapter, instead of re-teaching it — see the Concept Ownership Rule in
[STYLE_GUIDE.md](STYLE_GUIDE.md).

**Do not edit this file directly from a chapter-authoring session.** Chapters
propose new concepts in their own `review/concept-proposals/<chapter-id>.md`
staging file; a separate merge step (run once after a batch of chapters
finishes) consolidates proposals here. This avoids concurrent-write conflicts
when multiple chapters are authored in parallel, isolated sessions.

## Ownership table

| Concept | Owning Chapter | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| HTTP status codes | [HTTP](05_Networking_and_OS/CH01_HTTP.md) | Full taxonomy (1xx-5xx), semantics, retry implications |
| HTTP caching headers (`Cache-Control`, `ETag`, etc.) | [HTTP](05_Networking_and_OS/CH01_HTTP.md) | Browser/CDN/proxy caching layers |
| HTTP methods (GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) | [HTTP](05_Networking_and_OS/CH01_HTTP.md) | Semantics, idempotency, safety |
| TLS handshake | [HTTP](05_Networking_and_OS/CH01_HTTP.md) | Covered at the transport-security level relevant to HTTP/HTTPS |
| HATEOAS | [REST](08_API_Architecture/CH01_REST.md) | REST maturity model, hypermedia controls |
| Richardson Maturity Model | [REST](08_API_Architecture/CH01_REST.md) | REST-specific API design maturity levels |
| Resource modeling (REST) | [REST](08_API_Architecture/CH01_REST.md) | URI design, nouns vs verbs, resource relationships |

## How to add an entry

1. Confirm the concept isn't already listed above.
2. Add a row with the owning chapter (prefer the more foundational chapter when
   two candidates exist) and a one-line note on scope.
3. Remove the corresponding proposal from `review/concept-proposals/`.

## Merge log
